about.heading: About Me
about.subheading: A bit about my background and how I work.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Engineer with a background spanning intelligent transportation systems, infrastructure engineering, and software development. Over the past 6+ years I've worked across the full stack of ITS delivery — from field installation and calibration to building the software that monitors and controls those systems.

My MSc in Artificial Intelligence sharpened my focus on applying machine learning to real engineering problems: classifying vehicle types from trajectory data, predicting system faults before they happen, and automating workflows that used to take hours of manual work.
I care about building things that are reliable in production, not just accurate in a notebook — clear interfaces, sensible defaults, and systems that fail safely.

experience.role: Senior Service Engineer — Smart Infrastructure & ITS Systems
experience.description: Deploy, integrate, commission, and support intelligent traffic enforcement and ITS solutions across mission-critical sites in the UAE. Integrate cameras, LiDAR, sensors, control units, networking, databases, and backend platforms into reliable end-to-end systems, and lead FAT/SAT, calibration, and structured root-cause analysis.

Designed, assembled, and troubleshot electronic circuits, embedded control systems, and sensor-based automation. Programmed PIC, AVR, and Arduino microcontrollers, performed PCB prototyping and hardware debugging, and built VB.NET desktop applications for monitoring, diagnostics, and workflow automation.

Delivered project-based network and infrastructure engineering: routing, switching, firewall, VPN, MikroTik, and Ubiquiti environments, plus MPLS/OSPF/BGP/VRF design and simulation using GNS3 and Cisco platforms, with network diagrams, RF calculations, and technical reports.
